rows.grounds: middle voice third singular present of pra-jan

items.question: What arises when one knows that hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
The verse states arising of all-knowingness.
items.inference: All-knowingness arises from knowing that hidden true nature.
uncertainties: Exact internal compound parsing of gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
